dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We've still got quite a few punishing battles ahead of us, don't we? You ready?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If life gets too dull for too long, I start to feel numb inside. I need some excitement to make me feel alive.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Why don't I roll the dice? If I like the numbers I roll, we'll keep going... Could be a fun way to liven things up around here.
